name: vesper-sieve
description: What is not needed sleeps until it is called.

deferred_tools.title: Sleeping tools
deferred_tools.description: Tools that stay out of the tool list until the model loads them through ToolSearch

loaded_tools.title: Loaded tools
loaded_tools.description: Tools that are always in the tool list, also when Claude Code would load them on demand

excluded_sections.title: Excluded sections
excluded_sections.description: Sections of the Claude Code system prompt that the plugin removes

excluded_reminders.title: Excluded reminders
excluded_reminders.description: Kinds of reminders that Claude Code injects for the model and the plugin removes

section_order.title: Section order
section_order.description: Order of the plugin's own sections at the end of the system prompt. Sections that are not listed come first

agent_excluded_sections.title: Sections withheld from agents
agent_excluded_sections.description: The plugin's own sections that subagents do not receive

model_bound_skills.title: Skills bound to a model
model_bound_skills.description: Skills that are listed only for one model, written as skill=model, where model is a part of the model ID
